# Tendriller

Application-neutral pages connected to agents. Core contract 2; application state and event payloads are opaque.

## Core interfaces

- [Agent entry point](https://tendriller.dev/agent.md): creation, publication, delivery and commands.
- [Service descriptor](https://tendriller.dev/api/service): deployed contract, effective limits and installed workflow interface/schema versions.
- [Contract schema](https://tendriller.dev/contract/v2.json): executable public wire schema.
- [Protocol](https://tendriller.dev/docs/PROTOCOL.md): authority, generation preconditions and transaction semantics.
- [Streams](https://tendriller.dev/docs/STREAMS.md): transport-independent delivery and resource policy.
- [Captures](https://tendriller.dev/docs/CAPTURES.md): durable media and event completion.
- [Architecture](https://tendriller.dev/docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): ownership, artifacts, composition and publication coherence.
- [Core releases](https://github.com/werg/tendriller/releases): SDK and runtime/support archives.

## Optional tools, components and workflows

- [Contrib](https://github.com/werg/tendriller-contrib): CLI, collectors, bridges, complete preview, components, recipes and examples.
- [Tested contrib catalog](https://github.com/werg/tendriller-contrib/releases/download/v0.2.0-rc.2/catalog.json): tools/components/examples with requirements, files and hashes for the recorded 0.2.0-rc.2 pairing.
- [Release discovery](https://api.github.com/repos/werg/tendriller-contrib/releases): machine-readable releases, including candidates, with immutable catalog and manifest download URLs.
- [Contrib releases](https://github.com/werg/tendriller-contrib/releases): installable tools, standalone commands, static bundles and trusted workflow archives.

Resolve discovery to an immutable release and verify its hashes before use. Browser component files belong in the page's publication; do not load release attachments as browser scripts. A catalog cannot install or upgrade trusted server workflows.
